title: deliverable (Work/<spoke>/deliverables/<name>.md) lifecycle contract
description: Thin lifecycle-only contract for durable, human/agent-authored deliverables under the Work/ surface — the durable + human-authored quadrant the binder, library, and workshop do not fill. Deliverables are heterogeneous (a brief, a deck-source, a memo, and a multi-page report share no body shape), so this contract governs frontmatter and lifecycle ONLY: it carries no body-structure and no length governance, leaving the body free-form. The frontmatter type registration (type: deliverable) lives in governance/frontmatter-rules.json#types.deliverable; this contract carries the lifecycle enums (status, audience) and the audit-time placement signal. Enforcement is AUDIT-TIME via the librarian suite over the Work/ symlink view — a deliverable authored from a work-spoke launch lands outside the vault root, so no write-time guard fires.

_design_notes.consumer: skills/librarian audit suite (index-maintain / placement-validate / frontmatter-enforce / xref-check) covers Work/** at audit-time via a scoped invocation (--scope <vault>/Work) — the whole-vault walk does not recurse into the Work/ symlink, so deliverables are reached the same way library-index reaches the _library root; no write-time guard fires on deliverables authored outside the vault root.
_design_notes.thin_contract_note: Models the minimal-viable file-type stub shape (frontmatter + lifecycle, free-form body), NOT the rich library-article body-structure shape — deliverables are too heterogeneous for a single body contract. Per-deliverable-kind structure governance is an archetype subtype layered via overlay-master.json, not part of this base contract.
_design_notes.evolution_protocol: R-37 atomic lockstep — this runtime artifact + governance/frontmatter-rules.json#types.deliverable (the type registration) + governance/foundation-master.json forward-composed move in one commit.

routing: A markdown file under the Work/ surface that declares type: deliverable in its frontmatter activates this contract; placement under Work/** is an audit-time advisory (the type's expected_path), never a write-time matcher.
contract_rationale: A deliverable is durable, project-scoped work product the author owns and edits across its lifecycle, so the contract governs only the lifecycle frontmatter and leaves the body free-form; deliverables are too varied in shape for one body-structure to fit, and per-kind structure belongs to an archetype subtype rather than the universal base.
audience_rationale: The base audience values stay internal and external so the universal vocabulary remains archetype-neutral; a narrower refinement of the external value is an overlay subtype an adopter adds for their own publish tooling, not a base value the foundation ships.
